title: Enhance SVG output with interactivity
description:
Add interactivity to 'pebbles flow --format svg' output:

- Hover tooltips showing full issue details (title, description, status)
- Visual highlighting of critical paths (with --goal)
- Proper edge routing (avoid overlaps)
- Responsive sizing based on graph complexity
- Export option: standalone HTML with embedded JavaScript for interactivity

Consider: click an issue to jump to it in the TUI, zoom/pan for large graphs, filter toggle buttons in the HTML export.

Notes (2026-10-06): originally sequenced (scheduled_before) before 'Design TUI interactive flow browser', which is done (2026-09-20); that ordering no longer applies. The base SVG review/tuning is tracked in e99e93c5; this pebble is the follow-on enhancement.
